chunks: As for what Sa'd narrated from Abū al-Jawzā’, from al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿUlwān, from ʿAmr ibn Khālid, from Zayd ibn ʿAlī عليه السلام, he said:
I prayed behind my father in the Maghrib prayer, and he forgot Fātiḥat al-Kitāb in the first rakʿah, so he recited it in the second.

key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind, in congregation following an Imam
key_terms.فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ: Sūrat al-Fātiḥah, the opening chapter recited in prayer

ai.seo_question: What happens if Fātiḥat al-Kitāb is forgotten in the first rakʿah of prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an instance in the Maghrib prayer where Fātiḥat al-Kitāb was forgotten in the first rakʿah and then recited in the second. It is cited in a chapter concerning one who forgets the recitation, indicating its relevance to prayer rulings related to omission in salat.
